description: This file is a PHP source file that generates an HTML page for adding port forwarding rules via a web interface. It includes PHP code for server-side processing, embedded JavaScript for client-side validation and interactions, and HTML for the form layout.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Converts an IPv6 address with '::' shorthand into expanded full form as an array.

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks if all input fields with a given prefix are blank.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates values of input fields with a prefix into a single address string separated by a specified separator.

methods.name: isIp6AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv6 address inputs are required based on current form state.

methods.name: isIp4AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv4 address inputs are required based on current form state.
